builds.howItPlays: You send units into showdowns backed by stun spells and abilities, and every enemy unit you stun lets Leona hand one of your units a lasting buff. Turn after turn your side keeps getting stronger while the stunned opponents can't fight back at full strength, so you grind out the battlefields you need to win.
builds.whyYou: You like taking the fight to your opponent but on your own terms, picking exactly when to stun and swing. You don't mind a longer game where your advantage builds slowly, and you get satisfaction from watching your units grow turn after turn until the opponent can't keep up. If patient pressure and stacking small advantages appeal to you more than an early knockout, Leona suits you.
builds.ratingNotes: pace 2.5: riftbound.gg calls Leona's key removal spell 'quite expensive tempo wise' and 'a late-game tool first and foremost', while riftstorm.gg says the deck 'does not need to race you' and is 'not the fastest deck in the format'; not the slowest either since showdowns start paying off once buffs stack. stance 3: riftbound.gg frames the plan as attacking into stuns to force removal ('we are looking to force our opponent to use removal spells to take out our units, as their unit get stunned during showdowns'), which is proactive commitment, but also lets Leona 'be reactive during her opponent's turn' with counter-stuns and combat tricks, so it sits closer to reactive than proactive overall. complexity 6.5: riftbound.gg describes 'high decision-making, centered on stun and buff synergies' requiring 'careful sequencing of spells, unit placement, and combat management'; riftstorm.gg frames it as a timing game around 'one stun does two jobs at once', moderate rather than extreme. variance 4: riftbound.gg notes 'moderate variance due to spell-dependent gameplay' and flags one card as 'the most important card as it also draws, something this legend can struggle with', so weak draw support adds swing beyond a pure grind plan. Legend ability: whenever you stun one or more enemy units, buff a friendly unit (a fresh buff is +1 Might). Confidence: medium, only two sources found and neither is a deep-dive tournament report; the archetype call (Midrange over pure Control) follows riftbound.gg's own 'Midrange/Control' label. Reviewer should double check whether a starter deck exists for Leona; none was found in this pass.
